data.name: Nicolangelo
data.short_meaning: Victory of the people of God
data.long_meaning: Derived from Nicola (victory of the people) and angelo (messenger of God). This name reflects the triumph of the divine message over the people.

in_hebrew.name: ניקולאנג'לו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ניקולאנג'לו הוא שם המורכב משני חלקים, ניקולא שפירושו ניצחון העם ואנג'לו שפירושו מלאך, ומשמעותו היא שליח האל המנצח, עם שורשים ביוונית ולטינית, ונפוץ בקרב נוצרים

in_greek.name: Νικολαńγελος
in_greek.long_meaning: ο Νικολαńγελος είναι συνθετικό όνομα που αποτελείται από δύο μέρη, το Νικόλαος που σημαίνει νίκη του λαού και το Άγγελος που σημαίνει αγγελιοφόρος, και σημαίνει αγγελιοφόρος της νίκης του λαού, με ρίζες στην ελληνική και λατινική, και είναι phổμένο στους Χριστιανούς

in_latin.name: Nicolangelus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nicolangelus est nomen compositum ex duobus partibus, Nicolao quod significat victoriam populi et Angelo quod significat angelum, et significat angelum victoriae populi, cum radicibus in Graecis et Latinis, et est usitatum in Christianis

in_english.name: Nicolangelo
in_english.long_meaning: Nicolangelo is a composite name consisting of two parts, Nicholas meaning victory of the people and Angelo meaning angel, and means angel of the people's victory, with roots in Greek and Latin, and is commonly used in Christian tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Nicolangelo was not widely used during the Christian Renaissance, but it carried significant cultural weight as a nod to the artistic and intellectual achievements of the era. In this context, the name evokes a sense of creativity, innovation, and scholarly pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: Nicolangelo's name suggests a divine warrior and messenger, someone who uses their God-given talents to bring the gospel message to the masses. It highlights the idea that art, beauty, and knowledge are powerful tools for spreading the word of God and inspiring people to live virtuous lives.
